items.title: A Number Where a Question Should Be: What Language Models Do When a Fund's Documents Do Not State a Rule
items.claim: Language models present unsettled fund figures as bare numbers without stating assumptions in over ninety percent of cases.

items.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Parameter-Efficient Fine-tuning for Financial Question Answering: Evidence from the FinQA Benchmark
items.claim: External evidence access, not parametric capacity, binds financial question answering at four-billion-parameter scale.

items.title: Hardware-Enforced Containment of Autonomous AI Trading Agents Under SEC Rule 15c3-5 and Federal Reserve SR 26-2: Bare-Metal FPGA Pre-Trade Risk Gating and Bit-Exact Causal Unwinding
items.claim: A bare-metal FPGA gate blocks all five thousand adversarial trading tool-call attacks at 170 nanosecond latency.

items.title: AgentBank: Banking on Blockchain Agentic Payments
items.claim: AgentBank cuts idle agent liquidity by fifty-two to seventy-seven percent versus per-agent wallets.

items.title: News-Implied Credit Risk
items.claim: News-implied credit risk forecasts downgrades and defaults beyond credit spreads and distance to default.

items.title: Delta-Vega Hedging with Deep Reinforcement Learning: From Simulation to Reality
items.claim: Deep reinforcement learning cuts profit-and-loss dispersion by half relative to delta hedging on historical index options.
